messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed both issues: each size keeps its lowest move count, and unfinished sizes show “none”. Added regression coverage for switching sizes and reloading.

Typecheck, build, and 140 tests pass. All 77 browser journeys passed their assertions; two required longer diagnostic timeouts.

Changed files pass formatting. Existing warnings remain in [replay.test.ts](/work/scripts/replay.test.ts), [accessibility.e2e.test.ts](/work/tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts), and [layout.e2e.test.ts](/work/tests/layout.e2e.test.ts).
